title: CIA killed Ahmad Shah Massoud before 9/11; US created al-Qaeda to fight the Soviets

tellings.quote: Ahmed Shaw Masoud leading the northern alliance was a decent guy and the CIA killed him right before 911.

plain: The researcher Jason Jorjani tells Michels that the CIA killed Ahmad Shah Massoud, the Afghan commander who led the Northern Alliance, "right before 9/11", and calls Massoud "a decent guy". Jorjani also says the US created al-Qaeda to fight the Soviets after 1979, and he names no source for either claim. If true, it would mean American intelligence shaped the very forces it later went to war against.
